Key responsibilities include:

  • Review and contribute to strategy and planning defintion of the test effort
  • Analyze and review solution requirements and specifications
  • Create test designs including defining test scenarios, test cases and test scripts
  • Procure test data for test executions
  • Provide assistance to set up test environments
  • Execute tests and report issues
  • Participate in managing test defects
  • Monitor test execution and gather metrics to communicate test progress, solution quality and test results
